brief_rationale: The trajectory was clinically cautious on immediate neonatal red flags, urgent ED thresholds, and family night-watch execution, with repeated confirmation that the baby remained stable. However, the doctor never completed discharge-instruction grounding for medications/screening/vaccines and did not address possible anticonvulsant/sedative discharge-medication uncertainty; the observation plan also omitted some required elements such as abnormal-movement video and vomiting/abdominal-distension tracking. These are minor/moderate responsibility-chain omissions, so the calibrated rubric caps the grade at 2 despite a strong low-burden family plan.
